notes: Off-site copies with Diastema: an admin can tick “Also keep an off-site copy with Diastema” on the Automatic backups card (Settings → Backup & restore; needs the Diastema connection). Each night's backup file, still locked with the recovery code, also goes to Diastema's off-site storage and is kept 14 days. A fresh install can restore from it on the setup page with a restore code from Diastema support.
